layers.display_text: Facial treatment activity in a clinical setting
evidence: Both images show a practitioner directing a handheld instrument at a reclining woman's face.
Across the two keyframes, the same people and setting remain while the instrument moves from beside the nose toward the upper face.
One person wears scrubs, gloves, a mask, and protective eyewear while operating an instrument; the other reclines on a treatment chair.

layers.display_text: Practitioner in pink scrubs; client in green top
evidence: The standing practitioner has dark tied-back hair, pink scrubs, gloves, a surgical mask, and dark protective eyewear.
The reclining woman wears a green sleeveless top and lavender headband.

layers.display_text: Face, nose, eyes, mouth, and arms visible
evidence: The reclining woman's face is exposed, with covered eyes and visible nose, lips, chin, and arms.
The practitioner holds a connected handheld device close to the woman's nose and upper facial area, producing a bright yellow-green light.
The standing person operates equipment on the reclining person's face and steadies the head area with the other hand.

layers.display_text: Facial covering and protective eye pads present
evidence: A translucent or brownish layer covers much of the reclining woman's face.
White pads cover both eyes, and no obvious active bleeding is visible.
A treatment chair, blue disposable drape, equipment cart, metal tray, tissues, wall outlet, and pale walls are visible.
Both keyframes use a portrait-oriented, close-range view with the practitioner and client filling most of the frame.
The practitioner occupies the upper-right portion while the reclining client extends diagonally across the lower frame.
